list.title: Milan Momcilovic Highlights
list.description:
Like, comment, and subscribe!

Junior season highlights of 6'8 2023 forward Milan Momcilovic of Pewaukee High School. Milan helped lead his team to their second straight state title while averaging 18.1 ppg, 7.7 rpg, and 2.6 apg. He was named Conference Player of the Year and also became Pewaukee's all-time leading scorer with 1,236 career points. Milan holds offers from Minnesota, Marquette, Iowa State, Oral Roberts, and Milwaukee.
